ownerDecisions.subject: regime taxonomy authority
ownerDecisions.decision: The GATE24 regime taxonomy is no longer a single flat enumeration. It is a versioned, per-dimension taxonomy set carried by RegimeVector(T), declared in regimeVectorV1. Taxonomy entries are Owner-ratified per dimension and closed under EXACT_ONLY for every dimension declared ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1. No agent may invent, infer or extend taxonomy entries for any dimension.
ownerDecisions.history: The pre-repair R0 draft invented a Trend x Volatility 3x3 composition; REPAIR_1 retracted it as agent invention and set OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED; REPAIR_2 closes the question with the Owner-directed dimensional architecture in OD-A through OD-G.

ownerDecisions.subject: admissible classifier inputs and the upstream input boundary
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-J. Two explicit boundaries only: MARKET_FEATURE_BOUNDARY (GATE23 FeatureRecord(T)) and MACRO_CONTEXT_BOUNDARY (prepared, versioned causal MacroContext(T)). GATE22 Outcome and labels are forbidden as classifier inputs directly, lagged, renamed, type-laundered or derived from a future outcome. No raw observation access that bypasses these boundaries is admissible.

ownerDecisions.subject: classification as-of boundary
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-K. K(T) = PinnedCanonicalSession(T).closeUtc, inherited unchanged from GATE23 OD-5. marketSession.mjs::sessionCloseUtc and wall-clock constants remain forbidden. GATE24 creates no alternative cutoff.

ownerDecisions.subject: transition semantics
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-Q, OD-R and OD-S. The proposal status assigned in REPAIR_1 is lifted: PERSIST/CHANGE typing on primaryMarketRegime plus a changedDimensions overlay is Owner-directed.

ownerDecisions.subject: hysteresis and minimum dwell
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-T. hysteresis = DEFER and minimumDwell = DEFER. No arbitrary dwell of 3, 5 or 10 sessions is imposed. The first implementation must measure real transition frequency; any future stabilization must be evidence-based and coverage-tested.

ownerDecisions.subject: fail-closed and non-classification
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-M. Fail-closed is dimension-local: a dimension whose required CORE inputs are missing resolves to its own INSUFFICIENT_DATA member without collapsing the whole vector.

ownerDecisions.subject: parameter binding and point-in-time immutability
ownerDecisions.decision: All thresholds, weights and window selections live in a declared, versioned parameter set bound by ParameterSetId. Inline magic constants are forbidden. Any change produces a new ParameterSetId and, where a taxonomy changes, a new taxonomy version. Republication never rewrites historical RegimeRecords. Macro vintage revision never rewrites an emitted RegimeRecord.

ownerDecisions.subject: cross-sectional scope
ownerDecisions.decision: CROSS_SECTIONAL is DEFER, consistent with GATE23 OD-3. V1 is per-instrument time-series classification only. Market-wide macro context is not cross-sectional construction: it is a shared, non-peer-relative context computed once and reused.

ownerDecisions.subject: determinism
ownerDecisions.decision: Identical bound inputs, identical taxonomy versions, identical classifier version, identical parameter set and identical macro context binding must yield an identical RegimeRecordId and an identical RegimeVector. No wall-clock, locale, iteration-order or floating-point-order dependence is admissible in the identity path. Macro arithmetic preserves the exact fixed-point discipline of its producer.

ownerDecisions.subject: macro context perimeter
ownerDecisions.decision: See OD-H. The macro perimeter is a four-tier registry: CORE_V1, OPTIONAL_V1, REGISTERED_DEFERRED, FUTURE_EXTENSION. Promotion between tiers requires an explicit Owner decision and a new macro context version. No silent promotion. GATE24 consumes prepared, versioned macro context only.

ownerDecisions.subject: RegimeVector multidimensionnel
ownerDecisions.decision: GATE24 produces RegimeVector(T): a set of independent, independently versioned dimensions. It must not produce a single large cartesian label. Concatenated forms such as BULL_VOLATILE_DISINFLATION_RATES_FALLING_CURVE_INVERTED are forbidden as emitted regime values. The architecture must be able to represent all ten declared dimensions without a future identity change or structural rebuild; not all dimensions are required to be active in CORE_V1.
ownerDecisions.dimensionCountNote: REPAIR_3 splits the curve dimension, taking the declared architecture from ten to eleven dimensions.

ownerDecisions.subject: primaryMarketRegime V1 taxonomy
ownerDecisions.decision: Closed V1 taxonomy for primaryMarketRegime: BULL, BEAR, RANGE, CRISIS, RECOVERY, TRANSITION, LIQUIDITY_STRESS, REGIME_UNKNOWN, REGIME_INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Calm and volatile variants of bull and bear are representable as the combination of primaryMarketRegime and volatilityState and must never be encoded as additional primary entries. The primary enumeration may not be cartesian-expanded.

ownerDecisions.subject: volatilityState
ownerDecisions.decision: volatilityState is an independent dimension whose V1 vocabulary admits at minimum CALM, NORMAL, VOLATILE, EXTREME, UNKNOWN, INSUFFICIENT_DATA. No numeric threshold is defined in this mandate. Exact thresholds belong to a versioned ParameterSet and are frozen later by contract.

ownerDecisions.subject: inflationState
ownerDecisions.decision: Closed V1 taxonomy: INFLATIONARY, DISINFLATIONARY, INFLATION_STABLE, INFLATION_UNKNOWN, INFLATION_INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Inflation is not a competitor of BULL/BEAR; primaryMarketRegime = BULL with inflationState = DISINFLATIONARY is a valid vector.

ownerDecisions.subject: ratesState
ownerDecisions.decision: Closed V1 taxonomy: RATES_RISING, RATES_FALLING, RATES_STABLE, RATES_UNKNOWN, RATES_INSUFFICIENT_DATA. ratesState and fedPolicyState remain distinguishable dimensions and must not be merged.

ownerDecisions.subject: yieldCurveState
ownerDecisions.decision: Closed V1 taxonomy: CURVE_NORMAL, CURVE_FLAT, CURVE_INVERTED, CURVE_STEEPENING, CURVE_UNKNOWN, CURVE_INSUFFICIENT_DATA. It reuses the existing causal curve features SPREAD_10Y_2Y, SPREAD_10Y_3M, SPREAD_5Y_2Y and the producer inversion vocabulary. No numeric threshold is defined here.
ownerDecisions.supersessionNote: REPAIR_3 splits yieldCurveState into the orthogonal dimensions yieldCurveShape and yieldCurveDirection and adopts the exact producer tokens. The CURVE_ prefixed entries declared in OD-F are retired and are not emitted.

ownerDecisions.subject: extended dimensions
ownerDecisions.decision: growthState, laborState, creditState, liquidityState and fedPolicyState exist in the architecture as versionable, extensible dimensions. No detailed closed taxonomy is invented for them where no prior canonical authority imposes one. Each is recorded as PROPOSED, DEFERRED or NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1 and each carries at minimum a fail-closed representation with UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA members.
ownerDecisions.supersessionNote: REPAIR_3 closes the disposition of the five extended dimensions as REGISTERED_NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1 with detailed taxonomy DEFERRED_TO_FUTURE_VERSION.

ownerDecisions.subject: macro registry tiers
ownerDecisions.decision: The macro registry declares exactly four classes: CORE_V1, OPTIONAL_V1, REGISTERED_DEFERRED, FUTURE_EXTENSION. A series moves between classes only by explicit decision and version. Silent promotion is forbidden in both directions.
ownerDecisions.closureNote: REPAIR_3 closes OPTIONAL_V1 as EMPTY_IN_V1 (OD-Z). The tier remains architecturally declared.

ownerDecisions.subject: macro ingestion architecture
ownerDecisions.decision: Preserve FETCH_ONCE -> NORMALIZE -> VERSION_CACHE -> PRECOMPUTE -> REUSE. Macro ingestion is off the Wheel critical path; historical macro work is OFF_SCAN; network access during classification computation is forbidden; a live macro fetcher is forbidden; latest-reference reconstruction is forbidden; vintage-first; append-only versioned registry; availableAt required; pinned release-time policy; unknown release time is rejected fail-closed; future vintage leakage is forbidden; silent interpolation or proxying is forbidden; Wheel live scan latency target delta is ZERO. A macro snapshot is computed once and reused; it must never be refetched per ticker.

ownerDecisions.subject: input boundaries
ownerDecisions.decision: Two explicit boundaries are preserved. MARKET_FEATURE_BOUNDARY carries GATE23 FeatureRecord(T). MACRO_CONTEXT_BOUNDARY carries prepared, versioned causal MacroContext(T). GATE22 Outcome and labels are forbidden as classifier inputs direct, lagged, renamed, type-laundered, or derived from a future outcome.

ownerDecisions.subject: knowledge cutoff
ownerDecisions.decision: K(T) = PinnedCanonicalSession(T).closeUtc is preserved. Every input must carry its own proof that availableAt <= K(T). Any datum known only after K(T) is inadmissible at T, whatever its event time.

ownerDecisions.subject: RegimeRecord identity
ownerDecisions.decision: MacroContextBindingId is REQUIRED in the RegimeRecord identity, because identical market features, session and cutoff with a different macro vintage are different inputs and must produce a different RegimeRecordId. The identity binds at minimum InstrumentIdentityId where applicable, SessionDate, KnowledgeCutoff, FeatureVectorBindingId, MacroContextBindingId, RegimeTaxonomyVersionId, ClassifierVersionId and ParameterSetId. The identity must stay compatible with existing canonical identity patterns; exact materialization is frozen at contract.
ownerDecisions.closureNote: REPAIR_3 closes the identity: ten required members, including DatasetId_feature and MissingnessStateId. See OD-AA.

ownerDecisions.subject: missingness and fail-closed policy
ownerDecisions.decision: Fail-closed is dimension-local. A missing CORE input required by a dimension resolves that dimension to INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Missing inputs required by primaryMarketRegime resolve primaryMarketRegime to REGIME_INSUFFICIENT_DATA. An absent REGISTERED_DEFERRED indicator never blocks CORE_V1. Silent imputation, latest-value substitution, future backfill, interpolation of an unknown publication and unauthorized proxying are all forbidden.

ownerDecisions.subject: classification quality
ownerDecisions.decision: RegimeRecord carries a deterministic classificationQuality. Uncalibrated probabilities are forbidden: outputs such as '87% bull' may not be emitted without real statistical calibration, which GATE24 does not perform. classificationQuality is a declared state such as COMPLETE, PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT or CONFLICTING, or a deterministic versioned coverage score. The exact definition is frozen at contract.

ownerDecisions.subject: classification evidence and explainability
ownerDecisions.decision: Every RegimeRecord must be able to explain why it exists through a classificationEvidence structure covering the relevant families: trend, volatility, drawdown, liquidity, inflation, rates, curve, macro coverage and the parameter set used. Evidence must be causal, reproducible and free of any future data.

ownerDecisions.subject: provenance
ownerDecisions.decision: Every RegimeRecord must be traceable to FeatureVectorBindingId, MacroContextBindingId, ParameterSetId, classifier version, taxonomy version, KnowledgeCutoff, data coverage and evidence/provenance references. No opaque regime without provenance.

ownerDecisions.subject: transitions
ownerDecisions.decision: Between two consecutive canonical sessions, an identical primaryMarketRegime yields PERSIST and a different primaryMarketRegime yields CHANGE. A changedDimensions list records overlay changes independently, so a macro overlay change never automatically becomes a primary regime change.

ownerDecisions.subject: regime age
ownerDecisions.decision: RegimeRecord carries regimeAgeSessions: the number of consecutive causal sessions since entry into the current primaryMarketRegime. It must be computable without any future information.

ownerDecisions.subject: last transition
ownerDecisions.decision: RegimeRecord carries lastTransitionSession or its canonical equivalent, so future consumers can distinguish an established regime from a recent change without recomputing the whole history.

ownerDecisions.subject: hysteresis and dwell
ownerDecisions.decision: hysteresis = DEFER and minimumDwell = DEFER. No arbitrary minimum of 3, 5 or 10 sessions is imposed. The first implementation must measure real transition frequency; any future stabilization must rest on evidence and coverage tests, must be strictly backward-looking, and may never rewrite an emitted RegimeRecord.

ownerDecisions.subject: performance
ownerDecisions.decision: GATE24 must not slow the Wheel scanner. The macro snapshot is computed once and reused across N tickers; there is no per-ticker macro network request; no historical recompute occurs on the live path; the live scan critical path MUST_NOT_LENGTHEN and the latency target delta is ZERO.

ownerDecisions.subject: test and validation expectations
ownerDecisions.decision: The mandate requires, at minimum, the sixteen validation classes enumerated in validationExpectations V-1 through V-16, plus the preserved perimeter and closure checks V-17 through V-20. These are expectations for a future contract and build; this mandate authorizes no test execution.

ownerDecisions.subject: CORE_V1 active dimension set
ownerDecisions.decision: The CORE_V1 classifier operates on exactly six dimensions: primaryMarketRegime, volatilityState, inflationState, ratesState, yieldCurveShape and yieldCurveDirection. All remaining dimensions stay architecturally registered and NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1.

ownerDecisions.subject: split of yieldCurveState into shape and direction
ownerDecisions.decision: yieldCurveState is replaced by two orthogonal dimensions, yieldCurveShape and yieldCurveDirection, each independently versioned and independently emitted. A record may carry yieldCurveShape = INVERTED together with yieldCurveDirection = STEEPENING. No composite curve label is produced. Both dimensions reuse the exact canonical producer tokens; no token is invented, re-spelled or prefixed. The producer-to-GATE24 mapping is exhaustive and no producer value is silently collapsed into a different class, in particular PARTIALLY_INVERTED, MIXED, FLATTENING and UNCHANGED.

ownerDecisions.subject: extended dimensions disposition
ownerDecisions.decision: growthState, laborState, creditState, liquidityState and fedPolicyState are REGISTERED_NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1. Their detailed classifying taxonomy is DEFERRED_TO_FUTURE_VERSION and no class is invented now. Each keeps its architectural fail-closed members UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA. This deferral does not block a CORE_V1 contract freeze.

ownerDecisions.subject: OPTIONAL_V1 tier
ownerDecisions.decision: OPTIONAL_V1 is EMPTY_IN_V1. The tier exists architecturally but no member is promoted into it in GATE24 V1, and no silent promotion from REGISTERED_DEFERRED is admissible.

ownerDecisions.subject: RegimeRecord identity closure
ownerDecisions.decision: DatasetId_feature and MissingnessStateId are REQUIRED identity members. They join the previously required InstrumentIdentityId, SessionDate, KnowledgeCutoff, FeatureVectorBindingId, MacroContextBindingId, RegimeTaxonomyVersionId, ClassifierVersionId and ParameterSetId, for ten required members. No existing provenance binding is removed. The exact ordered tuple and canonicalization remain frozen by the execution contract.

ownerDecisions.subject: CORE_V1 macro base source arithmetic
ownerDecisions.decision: The CORE_V1 macro perimeter holds twelve base source series: five Fed and monetary, five Treasury tenors, US.BLS.CPIAUCSL and US.BLS.UNRATE, that is 5 + 5 + 1 + 1 = 12. Derived features are counted separately and are not base sources. The earlier count of eleven was an arithmetic error and is corrected here; macro membership itself is unchanged and no deferred series is promoted.

validationExpectations.name: FUTURE LEAKAGE HOSTILE
validationExpectations.expectation: A future publication cannot modify an earlier T. Any attempt to influence T with data available only after K(T) is rejected.

validationExpectations.name: VINTAGE LEAKAGE HOSTILE
validationExpectations.expectation: A later revision cannot contaminate an older record. Historical replay uses the vintage available at T, never a later one.

validationExpectations.name: FOMC AS-OF
validationExpectations.expectation: A Fed decision is inadmissible before its availableAt under the pinned release-time policy.

validationExpectations.name: TREASURY AS-OF
validationExpectations.expectation: Treasury observations are inadmissible before their availableAt under the pinned release-time policy.

validationExpectations.name: MISSING CORE FAIL-CLOSED
validationExpectations.expectation: A missing CORE input resolves its dimension to INSUFFICIENT_DATA, and resolves primaryMarketRegime to REGIME_INSUFFICIENT_DATA when the primary inputs are missing. No silent imputation occurs.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED SERIES ABSENCE NON-BLOCKING
validationExpectations.expectation: Absence of a REGISTERED_DEFERRED indicator does not block or degrade CORE_V1 classification.

validationExpectations.name: PARAMETER VERSION MUTATION
validationExpectations.expectation: Any parameter, taxonomy or classifier change produces a new identity and version; historical records are never rewritten.

validationExpectations.name: EXACT REPLAY
validationExpectations.expectation: Identical bytes and versions reproduce an identical result, including an identical RegimeRecordId.

validationExpectations.name: TRANSITION PERSIST/CHANGE
validationExpectations.expectation: Consecutive sessions with an identical primaryMarketRegime yield PERSIST; a differing primaryMarketRegime yields CHANGE. Exactly one transition per consecutive pair in scope.

validationExpectations.name: CHANGED DIMENSIONS
validationExpectations.expectation: changedDimensions lists exactly the dimensions that differ from the prior classified session, and an overlay change never promotes itself into a primary CHANGE.

validationExpectations.name: CRISIS / FAST TRANSITION
validationExpectations.expectation: A fast regime change is emitted at the session it occurs, with no forward-looking smoothing, confirmation delay or retroactive revision.

validationExpectations.name: MACRO NETWORK OFF-SCAN
validationExpectations.expectation: Classification performs no network access, and no macro request occurs on the Wheel live scan path or per ticker.

validationExpectations.name: COVERAGE REPORT
validationExpectations.expectation: The coverage report accounts for every session in the declared scope with no unexplained gap, per dimension.

validationExpectations.name: PROVENANCE COMPLETENESS
validationExpectations.expectation: Every RegimeRecord traces to all fields required by provenanceV1; no opaque regime is emitted.

validationExpectations.name: MACRO BINDING IDENTITY DIFFERENTIAL
validationExpectations.expectation: Identical market features, session and cutoff with a different MacroContextBindingId must produce a different RegimeRecordId.

validationExpectations.name: LIVE SCAN PERFORMANCE NON-REGRESSION
validationExpectations.expectation: The Wheel live scan critical path measures a zero latency delta with GATE24 present.

validationExpectations.name: TAXONOMY CLOSURE
validationExpectations.expectation: Every emitted dimension value maps to exactly one declared entry of that dimension's taxonomy version; any out-of-enumeration value fails closed.

validationExpectations.name: EXPLICIT NON-CLASSIFICATION
validationExpectations.expectation: UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA members are distinguishable, counted per dimension and never silently substituted by a classifying entry.

validationExpectations.name: MACRO PERIMETER INTEGRITY
validationExpectations.expectation: Only CORE_V1 and, where populated, OPTIONAL_V1 members appear in consumed bindings; no REGISTERED_DEFERRED or FUTURE_EXTENSION item appears without an explicit tier promotion.

validationExpectations.name: NO CARTESIAN LABEL
validationExpectations.expectation: No emitted value concatenates multiple dimensions into a single composite regime label, and dimension values remain independently readable.

validationExpectations.name: CURVE MAPPING EXHAUSTIVENESS
validationExpectations.expectation: Every producer token of MACRO_FEATURE_CURVE_SHAPES and MACRO_FEATURE_CURVE_DIRECTIONS has exactly one declared GATE24 target; PARTIALLY_INVERTED, MIXED, FLATTENING and UNCHANGED are preserved and never collapsed into a different class; an unmapped or absent value fails closed to UNKNOWN or INSUFFICIENT_DATA and never to a classifying entry.

validationExpectations.name: CURVE SHAPE AND DIRECTION INDEPENDENCE
validationExpectations.expectation: yieldCurveShape and yieldCurveDirection are emitted independently; a record may carry INVERTED with STEEPENING, and no composite curve value is produced.

validationExpectations.name: EXTENDED DIMENSION NON-BLOCKING
validationExpectations.expectation: A registered but not active dimension emits only UNKNOWN or INSUFFICIENT_DATA and never blocks, degrades or fails a CORE_V1 classification.

validationExpectations.name: MULTI_HORIZON_IDENTITY_DIFFERENTIAL
validationExpectations.expectation: Same session, cutoff, feature vector and macro context with a different RegimeHorizonSpecId must produce a different RegimeRecordId.

validationExpectations.name: MULTI_HORIZON_EXACT_REPLAY
validationExpectations.expectation: The same horizon with the same inputs and versions reproduces an identical result, including an identical RegimeRecordId.

validationExpectations.name: CONSUMER_HORIZON_BINDING
validationExpectations.expectation: A consumer must bind an explicit horizon; no implicit fallback to the first available or to a global regime is admissible, including while only one horizon is active.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED_CAPABILITY_TRACEABILITY
validationExpectations.expectation: Every GATE24 capability declared deferred, registered-not-active, optional-later, future or out-of-scope-but-planned has a durable trace entry with a reason from the declared vocabulary and a revisit trigger.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED_PROMOTION_VERSIONING
validationExpectations.expectation: Promoting a deferred capability produces new versions and new identities and never mutates previously emitted records.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED_REVISIT
validationExpectations.expectation: A future gate readiness computation can surface the deferred and future capabilities targeting it and force a promote, keep-deferred, supersede or retire decision.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED_REASON_VALIDITY
validationExpectations.expectation: No deferred capability carries an empty reason or a non-vocabulary reason such as "later".

immutableInvariants.rule: GATE24 emits an independent, independently versioned RegimeVector. A single concatenated cartesian regime label is forbidden.
Every dimension taxonomy is Owner-ratified and closed under EXACT_ONLY before that dimension may be active. No agent may invent, infer or extend taxonomy entries.
A change in one dimension never implicitly implies a change in another; overlay changes never promote themselves into primaryMarketRegime changes.
Every dimension carries UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA members and fails closed locally without collapsing the vector.
Classification, evidence and transition derivation read only contemporaneous or prior inputs.
GATE22 Outcome and labels are forbidden as classifier inputs direct, lagged, renamed, type-laundered or derived from a future outcome.
K(T) = PinnedCanonicalSession(T).closeUtc is inherited from GATE23 OD-5 and is not redefined, overridden or relaxed by GATE24.
Every input carries its own proof that availableAt <= K(T); unknown release availability is rejected fail-closed.
MacroContextBindingId is a required identity member; a different macro vintage yields a different RegimeRecordId.
The macro registry has exactly four tiers and no series moves between them silently, in either direction.
GATE24 consumes prepared, versioned macro context; it performs no fetch, no ingestion and no normalization, and no network access occurs during classification.
A macro snapshot is computed once and reused across N tickers; per-ticker macro fetch or recompute is forbidden.
GATE24 must not lengthen the Wheel live scan critical path; all historical and macro work is off-scan and the latency delta is zero.
Omitting a session in scope is fail-closed and is a defect, never an implicit non-classification.
Identical bound inputs and versions reproduce identical RegimeRecordIds and identical RegimeVectors.
Later parameter, taxonomy, macro vintage or upstream restatement never rewrites an emitted RegimeRecord.
No regime is emitted without complete provenance and causal, reproducible evidence.
No probability, confidence percentage or uncalibrated score is emitted; classificationQuality is a deterministic declared state or versioned coverage score.
GATE24 consumes GATE21, GATE22 boundaries, GATE23 and the Directional Lab producers as read-only and modifies none of them.

The producer curve vocabularies map exhaustively onto yieldCurveShape and yieldCurveDirection using the exact producer tokens; no producer value is silently collapsed into a different class and unmapped values fail closed.
Curve shape and curve direction are separate dimensions and are never merged into a single composite value.
A registered but not active dimension carries only fail-closed members and never blocks CORE_V1 classification or a CORE_V1 contract freeze.
RegimeHorizonSpecId is a required identity member; two horizons on the same session are two different records, never one overwritten record.
Activating an additional horizon is additive and requires no identity redesign; one SessionDate implying exactly one possible regime forever is forbidden.
Consumers bind the horizon explicitly and can prove which one they consumed; implicit fallback is forbidden.
A capability deliberately deferred by GATE24 carries a durable trace with a reason from the declared vocabulary, promotion requirements and a revisit trigger; it is never silently dropped.
A deferred capability never becomes active silently; promotion requires an explicit decision, new versions, causal proof and tests, and never mutates prior records.

ratifies: The RegimeVector architecture: eleven registered dimensions, six active in CORE_V1 and five REGISTERED_NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CORE_V1, non-cartesian, with yield curve shape and direction orthogonal and the exact producer vocabulary mappings.
The macro perimeter: twelve CORE_V1 base macro sources, six derived macro features, OPTIONAL_V1 empty in V1, REGISTERED_DEFERRED and FUTURE_EXTENSION unchanged.

The RegimeRecord identity and provenance surface: the eleven required identity members, classificationEvidence, provenance, classificationQuality, changedDimensions, PERSIST and CHANGE, regimeAgeSessions and lastTransitionSession.
